title: Release is a sealed preflight followed by forward-only publication
decision:
P17.11 creates and verifies an immutable `publication-packet/v1` without external writes. P17.12 is
the only publication item, runs as `manual`, and requires G-RELEASE bound to the exact packet digest.
It reconciles every destination immediately before write, accepts only absent or byte-identical
state, records operations append-only and resumes partial progress from the same packet. It never
force-pushes, deletes or rewrites a published ref; a bad immutable release moves forward to a new
version.
rationale:
Local green checks cannot authorize live writes, while asking for approval before a sealed packet
does not identify what will be published. Forward-only recovery preserves the meaning of Composer
versions and GitHub releases after a partial multi-repository operation.

sections.title: Решение
sections.text:
P17.11 creates and verifies an immutable `publication-packet/v1` without external writes. P17.12 is
the only publication item, runs as `manual`, and requires G-RELEASE bound to the exact packet digest.
It reconciles every destination immediately before write, accepts only absent or byte-identical

sections.title: Почему
sections.text:
Local green checks cannot authorize live writes, while asking for approval before a sealed packet
does not identify what will be published. Forward-only recovery preserves the meaning of Composer
versions and GitHub releases after a partial multi-repository operation.

sections.title: Consequences
sections.text:
G-RELEASE grants only the enumerated `1.0.0` operations and does not grant repository creation,
visibility changes, secret provisioning, force, deletion or an unlisted registry write. The root
`CHANGELOG.md` is the release ledger; no per-package release ledger is added.
